gaps_and_uncertainty.detail: The odd-length example describes a Warp Marker at the end placed at the beginning of an even bar (bar eight in a nine-bar loop), then says to expose an eighth bar while discussing a missing last bar. The extracted prose is internally unclear as an exact boundary recipe. No diagram needed elsewhere; this one may need rendered-page inspection to resolve exact intended positions.
gaps_and_uncertainty.handling: Retained odd-length diagnosis and end-marker reveal technique; withheld the exact bar-number recipe. Count/verify real downbeats rather than guess.
gaps_and_uncertainty.parent_followup: If exact example positions are required, inspect the rendered source and test in Live.

gaps_and_uncertainty.detail: 7.5 still describes recording scene tempo/meter through scene names; 7.2.1 documents dedicated controls and migration of pre-Live-11 name values.
gaps_and_uncertainty.handling: Use explicit scene controls and verify recorded transitions; do not instruct current-version name parsing. Recording behavior itself not tested.

gaps_and_uncertainty.detail: 8.4.4 describes Arrangement fades via envelopes, while 6.8 explicitly distinguishes clip fade handles from automation envelopes.
gaps_and_uncertainty.handling: Distinguish Session Clip Fade from Arrangement clip fade handles; do not equate them with track automation.

gaps_and_uncertainty.detail: Assigned chapters do not provide a complete edition/point-release feature matrix, including Complex/Complex Pro or linked-track availability.
gaps_and_uncertainty.handling: No edition entitlement inferred. Check actual installed controls; own-sample-only Save Default restriction is retained.

gaps_and_uncertainty.detail: No numeric threshold is specified for short versus long samples.
gaps_and_uncertainty.handling: Describe policies without inventing a duration cutoff.

gaps_and_uncertainty.detail: All interface behavior and sound-quality recommendations are source-derived, not observed on the installed Live instance. No listening, Live test, automation capability test, performance benchmark, or edition check was performed.

Full MIDI tool algorithms, launch/Follow Action parameter behavior, groove system, automation, MPE, external synchronization and key/MIDI mapping setup beyond what these chapters state belong to other assigned references.
